seo.title: ClickHouse client for {devices}
seo.description: Query ClickHouse over HTTP or HTTPS, read Plan, Pipeline and Estimate EXPLAIN output, manage MergeTree parts and partitions, and watch mutations.

header.title: ClickHouse client
header.lead: Run analytical queries over HTTP, read plans and pipelines, and manage MergeTree parts and partitions.

bands.title: Connect
text: Enter a host, HTTP port, user and optional database, and switch databases without reconnecting; open tabs keep the database they started on.

Any SSL mode switches the connection to HTTPS. A port of 443 or 8443, the one ClickHouse Cloud uses, turns on Verify Identity, which checks the certificate against your CA file or the system trust store. Verify CA needs a CA file, and a client certificate and key reach servers that require mutual TLS.
Without TLS, reach a remote server through an <network>SSH tunnel</network> rather than sending plain HTTP across the network.

bands.title: Query and edit
text: The Explain menu offers Plan, Pipeline, AST, Syntax and Estimate. The indented output is drawn as a diagram or a tree, and Estimate shows the rows, marks and parts a query would read. A running query shows the rows read so far, Stop sends KILL QUERY, and the connection’s query timeout is passed to the server.

Inserts and UPDATE and DELETE mutations run from the grid. A successful save means accepted, not applied: follow progress in system.mutations. Materialized views are read-only. Point and ring tuples open on the Map view, and a query with its own FORMAT clause shows the server’s raw output in one column, so leave the clause off to get a grid.

bands.title: Tables, parts and monitoring
text: A table opens with Structure, Indexes, DDL and Parts tabs. Indexes shows the sorting key and data-skipping indices, DDL the full CREATE TABLE with engine and settings, and Parts reads system.parts, with Optimize, Drop Partition and Detach Partition. The Structure tab changes columns and drops data-skipping indices. The sorting key and primary key are fixed when a table is created, so add a data-skipping index with ALTER TABLE … ADD INDEX and recreate the table for other changes.
The Server Dashboard shows active queries, merges, part mutations and disk usage, ends other sessions, and lists finished queries that took longer than a second from system.query_log.

moveData: Import {importFormats} files, and export tables or results as {exportFormats}. A column with one value that is not valid UTF-8 shows as hex; select toValidUTF8(column) to read it as text.

faq.question: How do I change a setting for one query?
faq.answer: Put it in a SETTINGS clause on the query, such as SELECT … SETTINGS max_threads = 4. Each statement is its own HTTP request, so a separate SET is gone by the next one.

faq.question: Why does port 9000 not connect?
faq.answer: Port 9000 is ClickHouse’s native TCP port, which TablePro does not use. Connect to the HTTP port, or 8443 for HTTPS on ClickHouse Cloud; a request to /ping on that port answers Ok. when the HTTP interface is on.
